authority: Interpretation of frozen C5B-R5/C5K-P1-R6 execution binding and original R5, not an amendment to them
scope: 45 non-RF cases; CIC34, TON10, TON2 x LIN_SGD_LOGISTIC, HGB, MLP x seeds 11/23/37/53/71

explanation_target.general: SHAP explanations are in the assigned explainer's actual output space. When there is an explicit class axis, select the clean historical predicted class index, hold the same coordinate for all PF1 perturbations. Do not rebind on prediction flip.
explanation_target.TON2_LIN_HGB: If the assigned explainer truly exposes only one native scalar, retain native coordinate 0 regardless of predicted binary class; preserve historical score separately.

TON2_MLP.selection: fixed clean class coordinate of the raw two-logit axis
TON2_MLP.prohibited_substitution: Never label raw-logit SHAP as historical positive-probability SHAP, sum or select raw-logit SHAP as a probability explanation, or silently wrap the model.

PF4.background: 256 deterministic train-only rows, TON10 and TON2 dataset background shared
PF4.pairing: clean and one representation-effective deterministic PF1 candidate per intensity 0.01,0.05,0.10 and draw 0; NA stays NA
PF4.original_source_feature_aggregation_sign: sum encoded SHAP within same source feature
PF4.original_source_feature_magnitude: sum absolute encoded SHAP within same source feature
stability: Spearman of source-feature magnitudes, ties average
normalized L1 between unit-L1 source-feature magnitudes; both zero 0, exactly one zero 1
PF4.primary_fidelity: absolute local additivity residual in actual native explainer output space only where supported; no threshold; GradientExplainer N/A_FROZEN_NO_SUBSTITUTION
PF4.secondary_fidelity: top-k source feature ablation score drop @5/@10 through frozen preprocessing missing/baseline path, measured with CLEAN HISTORICAL PREDICTED CLASS SCORE, independent of the SHAP native target, no threshold
PF4.TON2_historical_score_clean_predicted_cl: For historical binary p1 from the sealed adapter, clean class 1 uses p1 and clean class 0 uses 1-p1; verify this against frozen helper for primary runner, do not confuse with raw-logit score.

PF5.prediction_stable: exact class unchanged clean versus same PF1 perturbation
PF5.source: C5B-R5 execution threshold precedence, not illustrative C3A example
